ideas.pitch: An autonomous incident tracking and data-lineage platform built for college labs that logs equipment failures and automatically generates repair workflows.
ideas.title: NightWatch Kolkata: Automated Campus & Lab Incident Response Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the data engineering agent pattern to solve a genuine problem faced by the host institution GCELT's lab administrators during late-night coding sessions.

ideas.pitch: A Halloween-themed smart workspace and mentor allocation platform featuring real-time availability tracking and automated team support routing.
ideas.title: SpookySync: Real-time Hackathon Workspace & Mentor Allocation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the Halloween-inspired theme and solves logistics pain points for the Event Management Group organizing DevNexus 2.0.

ideas.pitch: An automatic context-capture tool that records architectural decisions and code changes made during frantic 24-hour hackathons for instant post-event judging summaries.
ideas.title: GhoulGraph: Developer Knowledge Handover for 24-Hour Teams
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a pain familiar to every hackathon judge who has to evaluate raw codebases and undocumented midnight commits the next morning.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed biometric fatigue and stress detection system using local sensors to alert teams when they need mandatory caffeine or rest breaks.
ideas.title: EdgePhantom: Resilient IoT Health Monitor for Overnight Hackers
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard IoT engineering with a playful nod to the physical reality of surviving a 24-hour overnight code marathon.

ideas.pitch: A localized sustainability tracking portal optimized for college campuses to monitor smart bin capacities and power consumption during large tech fests.
ideas.title: EcoKolkata: Smart Campus Waste & Energy Tracking Portal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to institutional judges from GCELT by providing immediate practical utility for managing campus events cleanly and efficiently.
